ETH remains vulnerable to higher beta, negative alpha, and weaker liquidity. SOL and LTC are fragile: both are flat-rated with negative composites and alpha, while institutional and liquidity signals are adverse; keep exposure minimal or avoid. ES estimates of roughly 5%–8% reinforce capital-preservation priority.
